title: Panthera Pura Vida
style: Phonk with a sneaky mid-tempo bounce, rubbery sub slides, crisp hi-hat chatter, beatbox percussion, and playful Costa Rica folk-color accents; verse rides sparse drums and whispered callouts, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and vocal bass, chorus hits with stacked harmonic leads, gang doubles, and a panther chant. Ear candy includes marimba pops, jungle-bird stabs, reversed swells into drops, and coffee-cup foley hits. Bright, punchy, and mischievous with a glossy low-end, comedy
lyrics:
[Intro]
Pura vida, hey
Miau miau, ay
Beatbox on the corner
Tico in the night

[Verse 1]
Slip through San José like smoke
Pulpería grin, I vanish, joke
Gallo pinto on a paper plate
I swipe one fry, then I skate

Buseta bounce, I hear that horn
Rain on zinc and a shell still warm
Cancha dust on my boot sole
Panther laugh, with a velvet roll

[Pre-Chorus]
Shh, I’m by the fence
Mira, I go again
Coffee steam, black gold
Eyes on the mango tree

[Chorus]
Pura vida, panther
Pura vida, panther
Ay, qué rico, ay
Pura vida, panther

Pura vida, panther
Pura vida, panther
Sneak through the night
Then I say, “mae,” and bite

[Verse 2]
Limón on my lip, lime green grin
Surfboard lean when the tide rolls in
I tip my hat to the old señora
She says, “Qué lindo,” then I’m a hoorah

Volcán glow in the far sky blue
Two-step slide with a goofy crew
Marimba ping and a clap-clap snap
I’m the black cat in the sugarcane patch

[Pre-Chorus]
Shh, I’m by the fence
Mira, I go again
Drum of my chest
Then the whole block sings

[Chorus]
Pura vida, panther
Pura vida, panther
Ay, qué rico, ay
Pura vida, panther

Pura vida, panther
Pura vida, panther
Sneak through the night
Then I say, “mae,” and bite

[Bridge]
Eh-eh, miau
Beatbox, tongue drum style
Harmonic runs, so clean
And the whole town smiles

Eh-eh, miau
From the ridge to the sea
If you hear that purr
You already know it’s me

[Final Chorus]
Pura vida, panther
Pura vida, panther
Ay, qué rico, ay
Pura vida, panther

Pura vida, panther
Pura vida, panther
Sneak through the night
Then I say, “mae,” and bite

Pura vida, panther
Pura vida, panther
Miau miau, ay
Pura vida, panther
